items.context: Aapka account number batayenge?
Kaunse mahine ka bill hai?
Kitna zyada charge hua hai?
Kya aap online bill dekh sakte hain?
Ye charge kab ka lagaya gaya?
Kya aapne kisi international call kiya?
Aapke plan kaun sa hai?
Kya aapke paas bill ka screenshot hai?
Kya aapne recent data usage check kiya?
Kitne din se problem aa rahi hai?
Kya aapka number active hai?
Kya aap bill payment kar chuke hain?
Aapka registered mobile number kya hai?
Kya aapne plan upgrade kiya tha recently?
Kya aapko lagta hai koi extra call hua?
Kya aapka phone roaming par tha?
Aapke bill mein koi late fees dikha rahi hai?
Kya aapne customer care se baat ki thi pehle?
Aapko kis charge mein problem lag rahi hai?
items.text: Mujhe lagta hai ki data charge galat lagaye hain bill mein

items.context: Kya aap apna bill payment date bata sakte hain?
items.text: Maine payment kal kiya tha par bill abhi tak clear nahi hua

items.context: Kya aapne apne calls ka detail check kiya hai?
items.text: Haan maine dekha calls galat charge ho rahe hain mere hisaab se

items.context: Kaise hum aapki madad sabse pehle kar sakte hain?
items.text: Sabse pehle to meri billing galti ko thik karo please

items.context: Aapko kis tarah ka refund chahiye agar galti mile?
items.text: Bas jitna extra charge liya gaya wapas mil jaye to theek rahega

items.context: Kya aap kab tak is issue ko solve karwana chahenge?
items.text: Jaldi se jaldi kal tak solve ho jaye to acha rahega

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: telecom
Intent: bill_dispute - says a postpaid bill or charge is wrong
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').

The voice agent has just asked the customer a question, and the customer replies.
Write exactly 24 different (agent_question, reply) pairs. agent_question is one short question
the agent asks during this call; reply is the customer's complete answer to it.
- "short": exactly 18 pairs whose reply is 1-4 words,
- "medium": exactly 6 pairs whose reply is 5-12 words.
At least 8 replies must be complete answers that could also be the start of a longer
one, such as 'haan ji', 'theek hai', 'kal tak', 'abhi nahi', or a bare number (an amount, a date, an OTP).
Vary the questions. Do not number them.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"agent_question": "...", "reply": "..."}, ...], "medium": [...]}
Every question and reply must be in Latin script.
